memory_footprint_basis: 12.0 GiB is the CONTAINER CEILING (--memory=12g --memory-swap=12g --oom-score-adj=500), from ADDENDUM 1 Sec.A1.2: SO3's MEASURED precedent, the lab's own proven three-scenario multipoint on the same solver, which ran to 'EXIT: Optimal Solution Found.' at 12g. Raising it because there is now room would size a guard to the box instead of to the problem -- ADDENDUM 1's error run backwards. memory_floor_gb_basis: 14.0 GiB is the SEPARATE launch precondition of ADDENDUM 1 Sec.A1.5: the launcher reads /proc/meminfo at start-up and refuses with exit 75 below it. It is NOT a cap -- it never signals, stops, throttles or shortens any running solver -- it is a refusal to START when starting would take memory a live sibling relies on. At ADDENDUM 1 the box read MemAvailable 2.77 GiB and the precondition WOULD HAVE REFUSED, correctly. At this entry the box reads 120 GiB available of 123 (free -g, 2026-09-12), so it passes with 106 GiB of headroom. The THRESHOLD is not moved: a standing condition rewritten every time the hardware changes is not a standing condition.
